# `make_timestamp_ntz`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
make_timestamp_ntz(year, month, day, hour, min, sec)
```

Create local date-time from year, month, day, hour, min, sec fields. If the configuration `spark.sql.ansi.enabled` is false, the function returns NULL on invalid inputs. Otherwise, it will throw an error instead.

make_timestamp_ntz(date, time) - Create a local date-time from date and time fields.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `datetime_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.4.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | [2, 6] |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- make_timestamp_ntz, example 1
> SELECT make_timestamp_ntz(2014, 12, 28, 6, 30, 45.887);
2014-12-28 06:30:45.887
```

```sql
-- make_timestamp_ntz, example 2
> SELECT make_timestamp_ntz(2019, 6, 30, 23, 59, 60);
2019-07-01 00:00:00
```

```sql
-- make_timestamp_ntz, example 3
> SELECT make_timestamp_ntz(null, 7, 22, 15, 30, 0);
NULL
```

```sql
-- make_timestamp_ntz, example 4
> SELECT make_timestamp_ntz(DATE'2014-12-28', TIME'6:30:45.887');
2014-12-28 06:30:45.887
```
